item.title: There in the countryside, the Tallest Man On Earth reconnect…
item.author: Stereogum (@stereogum.com)
item.description:
There in the countryside, the Tallest Man On Earth reconnected with the local folk music he’d left behind to explore the sounds of American primitivism.

The result is a richer, more expansive approach shaped by traditional Swedish melodies and instrumentation. He even picked up a fiddle again.

item.title: It’s been 20 years since Kristian Matsson debuted as the Tal…
item.author: Stereogum (@stereogum.com)
item.description:
It’s been 20 years since Kristian Matsson debuted as the Tallest Man On Earth. Today, the singer-songwriter begins a new chapter with his third LP for ANTI-. ‘Just Beyond Endless Mountain’ was inspired by his return to Dalarna in central Sweden, where he grew up.

[📷: Anton Corbijn]
